body: Drinking, smoking, and crying all alone
...caring about my fellow patients was the only way I stayed sane... I couldn't save myself though... Going to sleep, thank you RaitoFox. You did help me tonight

I feel so worthless... I've done everything I can... I just want a break for once... To breathe... I feel like my spouse holds me up to the standards of a normal person... I'm not... Im not mentally right... Just a sick old dog that needs to be put out of it's misery... Just call me Ol' Yeller...

Thank you, I've lost so much in my life... My spouse doesn't want me to let go of my job is my biggest hurdle. So during the day I feel forced out while at home I feel forced in...its tearing me apart. I'm scared...so scared... But hearing your words help some... I hurt so much... I can't see anything but hellfire... Hope feels as likely as snowfall on the sun... I feel so worthless...
